name: Langshan
note: Park: Langshan (Wolf Hill) National Forest Park, a 110 m hill above the Yangtze with Buddhist temples and views; Wikivoyage and the Nantong government list it as a must-see.

name: Guangjiao Temple
note: Temple: Buddhist temple on the top of Langshan with a Ming-style Great Buddha Hall and the Song-dynasty Zhiyun Pagoda; Wikivoyage Nantong names it in the Langshan See entry.

name: Zhiyun Pagoda
note: Pagoda: 35 m five-storey Song-dynasty brick pagoda in the Guangjiao Temple grounds on Langshan; part of the same visit as Guangjiao Temple, kept only if it is a separate draw.

name: Cao Gong Zhu Memorial Temple
note: Temple: memorial temple to a local hero who defended Nantong against Japanese pirates in 1557, listed in Wikivoyage's Nantong See section.

name: Nantong Museum
note: Museum: Nantong Museum, founded in 1905 by Zhang Jian as China's first museum, a museum complex with garden courtyards beside the Haohe River.

name: Zhang Jian Memorial Hall
note: Museum: memorial hall on the former Haoyang Villa, the late-life home of industrialist and educator Zhang Jian; a visitor draw named in Nantong tour summaries, status to confirm.

name: Nantong Eminent Figures Museum
note: Museum: Nantong Eminent Figures Museum, a local-history museum on the city's notable figures, named in the Nantong government's recommended itinerary.

name: Nantong Textile Museum
note: Museum: first museum of its kind in China on the textile industry, opened 1985 with six exhibition halls and courtyard gardens; Wikivoyage Nantong See.
coordinates_source: osm:park 南通纺织博物馆 (museum name)

name: China Audit Museum
note: Museum: museum of accounting and auditing with abacus displays; Wikivoyage Nantong See item, a niche visit.
coordinates_source: osm:building 珠算博物馆·审计博物馆 (name match)

name: Nantong Overseas Chinese Museum
note: Museum: the Overseas Chinese museum in the Nantong Museum complex, free entry; Wikivoyage lists it as a separate See item.

name: Chinese Charitable Museum
note: Museum: museum on Zhang Jian's charitable work, in Nantong, named in the Nantong government's recommended itinerary for Japanese and Korean visitors.
coordinates_source: osm:building 中华慈善博物馆 (name match)

name: Chinese Ophthalmology Museum
note: Museum: the national ophthalmology museum in Nantong, named as a recommended visit in the Nantong government itinerary; a niche museum.

name: Nantong Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture Museum
note: Museum: traditional Chinese medicine culture museum in a building that blends traditional and modern styles, named in the Nantong government itinerary.

name: Stage Play School
note: Historic building: Stage Play School founded by Zhang Jian in 1919, listed on the Nantong China Daily attractions page; a heritage school building, public access to confirm.

name: Haohe River Scenic and Historic Spot
note: Waterway: the Haohe River, a 10 km ancient moat encircling central Nantong, with e-boat trips and evening lights; a National 5A scenic area.
coordinates_source: osm:tourist-info 濠河景区游客中心 (visitor centre point)

name: Five Mountains
note: Park: Five Mountains riverside greenway area on the Yangtze, named in the Nantong government itinerary for its river views and walks.

name: Tangzha Ancient Town
note: Historic town: Tangzha, the birthplace of Nantong's modern industry and a stop on Zhang Jian's industrial story, with relics of the first modern Chinese industrial heritage.
coordinates_source: osm:park 唐闸公园 (town centre not in OSM; park point, check)

name: Qiaolou Tower
note: Tower: Qiaolou Tower, a watchtower built in 1349 with a Western-influenced clock tower beside it in central Nantong; a Nantong government new scene.

name: Wenfeng Park
note: Park: Wenfeng Park with the 39 m Wenfeng Tower, Ming and Qing buildings and the Geyi Art Museum, named in the Nantong government's new scenes list.

name: Zhou Ji Green Expo Garden
note: Park: green expo garden in Nantong, a national 4A scenic spot, listed on the China Daily Nantong attractions page.

name: Kaisha Island
note: Island: Kaisha Island in the Yangtze, a provincial tourist resort with a development area of 15 sq km, listed on the China Daily Nantong attractions page.
coordinates_source: osm:village 开沙 (village point, island not in OSM)

name: Qixing Lake Ecological Park
note: Park: Qixing Lake ecological park in Hai'an, about 127 ha with a 500-mu water area, listed on the China Daily Nantong attractions page.

name: Wanyuan Pagoda
note: Pagoda: Wanyuan Pagoda at Yuantong Temple in northeast Hai'an, a national 3A scenic spot listed on the China Daily Nantong attractions page.

name: Jiangsu Jianghai Museum
note: Museum: the first state-owned museum in Haimen district, covering the Jianghai region's history; listed on the China Daily Nantong attractions page.

name: Zhongxiao Cultural Park
note: Park: Zhongxiao Cultural Park in Tongzhou district, built 2006 to 2008, listed on the China Daily Nantong attractions page.

name: Shuihui Garden
note: Garden: Ming- and Qing-era garden in northeast Rugao built around waterways, a classical Chinese garden in the Hui style; Chinese lists name it, no visitor source in hand.

name: Minsk Aircraft Carrier Park
note: Museum ship: the former Soviet aircraft carrier Minsk, open as a museum and park at Nantong's riverside; Chinese lists name it, no English visitor page in hand.

name: Nantong Forest Safari Park
note: Wildlife park: Nantong Forest Safari Park with about 20,000 animals, 300 species, a drive-through safari; Wikivoyage Nantong See.
coordinates_source: osm:theme_park 南通森林野生动物园

name: Nantong Sendi Ice and Snow Park
note: Attraction: indoor snow and ice park beside the Forest Safari Park, a permanent winter-sports venue; Wikivoyage Nantong See.
coordinates_source: osm:theme_park 森迪冰雪海洋乐园

name: Yangkou Port Scenic Area
note: Scenic area: Yangkou Port scenic area in Rudong, with Sun Island and tidal-flat clam-digging trips; a provincial scenic area named in Rudong's sources, no English visitor page in hand.
coordinates_source: osm:town 洋口镇 (town centre, scenic-area point to confirm)

name: Xiaoyangkou Tourist Resort
note: Scenic area: Xiaoyangkou tourist resort on the Rudong coast, an AAA scenic area and provincial resort; no English visitor page in hand.

name: Guoqing Temple (Rudong)
note: Temple: Guoqing Temple scenic area in Rudong, an AAA scenic spot; Chinese county lists only.

name: Qidong Golden Beach
note: Beach: Qidong's coastal sand beach, a self-drive stop on the Yangtze mouth coast; travel-aggregator mention only, no visitor source in hand.

name: Dafeng Milu Nature Reserve
note: Nature reserve: Dafeng Milu Nature Reserve, where Père David's deer were reintroduced in 1986, with a water tower, deer viewing platform and golf-cart tours; a flagship Yancheng draw, the official visitor page to confirm.

name: Holland Flower Park
note: Park: Holland Flower Park in Dafeng with Dutch-style architecture and tulip fields, a seasonal flower display in a permanent park; travel-aggregator mention only.

name: Zhonghua Shuihu Park
note: Park: Zhonghua Shuihu Park, a national 4A scenic theme park in Dafeng; Chinese list only.

name: Meihuawan Scenic Area
note: Scenic area: Meihuawan scenic area in Dafeng, a 4A scenic spot; Chinese list only.

name: Dongfang Wetland Park
note: Park: Dongfang Wetland Park in Dafeng, a 3A wetland park; Chinese list only.

name: Dafeng Red-crowned Crane Zoo
note: Wildlife park: Dafeng red-crowned crane zoo, a 3A scenic spot; Chinese list only.

name: One Piece Theme Park (Dafeng)
note: Theme park: One Piece animation theme park in Dafeng, listed in Chinese sources; a permanent venue, status to confirm.

name: Yancheng Coastal Wetlands
note: Nature reserve: Yancheng Coastal Wetlands, the largest coastal wetland reserve in China and part of the UNESCO Yellow Sea migratory bird sites, known for red-crowned cranes; Wikivoyage Yancheng names the coast and birdwatching.

name: Red-crowned Crane Wetland Ecotourism Area
note: Nature area: the red-crowned crane wetland eco-tourism area inside Yancheng's coastal wetlands reserve, the visitor entry to the crane wetlands; OSM feature only, likely the same visit as Yancheng Coastal Wetlands.
coordinates_source: osm:nature_reserve 盐城丹顶鹤湿地生态旅游区

name: Tiaozini Tidal Flat
note: Tidal flat: Tiaozini mudflat on the Dongtai coast, a bird stopover in the Yancheng wetlands; a travel-aggregator and UNESCO listing mention, no direct visitor page in hand.

name: Huanghai Forest Park
note: Park: Dongtai Huanghai (Yellow Sea) Forest Park, a coastal forest park with scenic trails, named in Wikivoyage Yancheng's cycling and hiking entry.

name: Xixi Ancient Town
note: Historic town: Xixi ancient town in Dongtai, cradle of the county and a Buddhist holy place, a 5A scenic area; Wikipedia and travel-aggregator mention only.

name: Haichunxuan Pagoda
note: Pagoda: Haichunxuan Pagoda in Dongtai, a national-level historical and cultural site; Wikivoyage Dongtai See.

name: Fuan Ming Dynasty Architectural Complex
note: Historic complex: Fuan Ming-dynasty architectural complex in Dongtai, a provincial heritage site; Wikivoyage Dongtai See, usually seen from outside.

name: Monument to the Anti-Japanese Martyrs of the Central Jiangsu Fourth Division
note: Memorial: monument to the anti-Japanese martyrs of the Central Jiangsu Fourth Division in Dongtai; a memorial listed in Wikivoyage Dongtai See.

name: Dongtai Former Residence of Feng Daoli
note: Historic house: former residence of Feng Daoli in Dongtai, a provincial heritage building; Wikivoyage Dongtai See.

name: Bao Family Building
note: Historic building: Bao Family Building in Dongtai, a provincial heritage building; Wikivoyage Dongtai See.

name: Kaizhuang Archaeological Site
note: Archaeological site: Kaizhuang site in Dongtai; Wikivoyage Dongtai See, a heritage site with little to see on the ground.

name: Former Residence of Lu Bingshu
note: Historic house: former residence of Lu Bingshu in Dongtai, a provincial heritage building; Wikivoyage Dongtai See.

name: Former Site of Dongming Electric Co.
note: Historic site: former site of the Dongming Electric Company in Dongtai, a provincial heritage site; Wikivoyage Dongtai See.

name: Dongtai City Museum
note: Museum: Dongtai City Museum, named by travel-aggregator lists; a local city museum, status to confirm.

name: Yancheng China Sea Salt Museum
note: Museum: China Sea Salt Museum in Yancheng on the city's salt-making history; Wikivoyage Yancheng See, free entry.

name: New Fourth Army Memorial Hall
note: Museum: New Fourth Army Memorial Hall in Yancheng, a Red Army history museum; Chinese Wikipedia names it among the city's attractions.

name: Yancheng Wild Animal World
note: Wildlife park: Yancheng Wild Animal World, a safari-style zoo in Yancheng; Wikipedia article, no visitor source in hand.

name: Yandu Park
note: Park: Yandu Park (Yandu, the old salt-trade name), a central city park; Chinese Wikipedia lists it among Yancheng's attractions.

name: Yancheng Water Street
note: Historic street: Yancheng Water Street, a waterside shopping and dining street with night lights; named in Chinese lists and a travel-aggregator guide.

name: Dazong Lake Scenic Area
note: Scenic lake: Dazong Lake scenic area in Yandu, a lake with a tourism area; Chinese lists and OSM attraction.

name: Yancheng Museum
note: Museum: Yancheng Museum, the city's main museum; Chinese Wikipedia lists it among the attractions.

name: Wetland Heritage Museum
note: Museum: Yellow Sea Wetland Museum (Wetland Heritage Museum) in Yancheng on the coastal wetlands; Chinese lists and OSM attraction.

name: Yongning Temple
note: Temple: Yongning Chan Temple in Yancheng, a Tang-dynasty temple; Chinese Wikipedia lists it.

name: Yan Cube TV Tower
note: Tower: Yan Cube TV tower in Yancheng; a landmark tower named in the Chinese Wikipedia attractions, observation access to confirm.

name: Dayangwan Ecotourism Area
note: Scenic area: Dayangwan eco-tourism scenic area in Yancheng (OSM attraction); no visitor or Wikipedia source in hand.
coordinates_source: osm:attraction 盐城大洋湾生态旅游景区

name: Yancheng Botanical Garden
note: Garden: Yancheng Botanical Garden (OSM park); no visitor or Wikipedia source in hand.

note: Nature reserve: Yeludang conservation area for dark and starry sky, a stargazing site (OSM); no visitor source in hand.
coordinates_source: osm:nature_reserve 中华暗夜星空保护地·野鹿荡

name: Binhai Park
note: Park: Binhai Park in Binhai county (OSM park); no visitor source in hand.

name: Yancheng Rare Bird National Nature Reserve
note: Nature reserve: Yancheng Rare Birds National Nature Reserve, the reserve name for the crane wetlands, same visit as Yancheng Coastal Wetlands; likely a duplicate.

name: Chenjiagang
note: Town: Chenjiagang, a salt-making and chemical-industry town in Xiangshui county; named only as a place, not a visitor draw.
